biggest_catch: This is an investigational imaging drug study: you receive an intravenous dose of 18F-OP-801 (not FDA approved) plus MRI and PET scans, and only about 3 visits over ~75 days earn the up-to-$2,200 — paid per completed visit.
catches: Not everyone qualifies: enrollment is limited (5 healthy volunteers initially, then 10 ALS patients + 10 age-matched healthy volunteers + AD/MS/PD patients across sites; UCSF enrolls up to 20 subjects) and you must be determined eligible after screening

Medical risks: intravenous administration of an investigational imaging agent (OP-801, not FDA approved); procedures include PET scans, MRI, blood draws, and physical exams — ask the study team about side effects and risks before consenting
Time commitment: approximately 75 days in the study with about 3 site visits — the Day 1 dosing visit includes MRI and PET scans and is a long visit day
Location-specific: visits are at UCSF in San Francisco, CA — no remote option
Paid per completed visit ($600 screening + $1,200 Day 1 dosing + $400 follow-up = up to $2,200); withdrawing early means you only keep pay for visits completed

c1.evidence: neuromuscular.ucsf.edu is the official UCSF Neuromuscular Division site; the research page lists trials that are currently enrolling.

c2.evidence: Official study page states 'you will be paid up to $2200 for taking part in this study. You will receive $600 for completing the screening visit, $1200 for completing the Day 1 dosing visit, and $400 for completing the follow up visit.'

c3.evidence: Official study page lists limited participant slots (healthy volunteers and ALS/AD/MS/PD patients; determined eligible after screening). No fee to participate stated or implied.

c4.evidence: Compensation (up to $2,200 with per-visit breakdown), eligibility (healthy volunteers + ALS/AD/MS/PD patients, screening-determined), and schedule (approx. 3 visits over ~75 days) all stated on the official UCSF study page.

eligibility: Healthy volunteers (initial enrollment) or patients with ALS, Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, or Parkinson's disease; must be determined eligible after screening. UCSF enrolls up to 20 subjects.
notes: One provider = one route. Anchored on the explicitly 'Enrolling' 18F-OP-801 Phase 1/2 imaging study (sponsor Ashvattha Therapeutics). Other UCSF Neuromuscular trials on the same page are separate opportunities under the same provider route.
numeric_basis: payout from official UCSF study page (per-visit: $600 screening + $1,200 Day 1 dosing + $400 follow-up = $2,200 max; min 0 if no visits completed); time: page states approximately 3 site visits over ~75 days but does not publish visit durations, so durations are estimated: 2h per visit (min) to 5h per visit (max; Day 1 includes MRI + PET imaging). 3 visits x 120-300 min.
payout_quote: In return for your time and effort, you will be paid up to $2200 for taking part in this study. You will receive $600 for completing the screening visit, $1200 for completing the Day 1 dosing visit, and $400 for completing the follow up visit.
payout_value_note: Paid per completed visit: $600 screening + $1,200 Day 1 dosing visit + $400 follow-up visit = up to $2,200 total; paid in USD.

steps: Go to the official UCSF Neuromuscular Division research page and find the 18F-OP-801 study (labeled Enrolling)
Email neuromuscular@ucsf.edu to express interest and confirm enrollment
Complete the screening visit (medical history review, physical exam) and be determined eligible
Attend the Day 1 dosing visit: receive one intravenous dose of 18F-OP-801 and undergo MRI and PET scans
Receive $600 (screening) + $1,200 (Day 1) + $400 (follow-up) = up to $2,200 for completed visits
timing: Approximately 75 days in the study with about 3 site visits: screening visit, Day 1 dosing visit (IV administration of OP-801, MRI, PET scans), and one follow-up visit.
